QUOTE: "The "not indexed by extension" count (`not_indexed` / `not_indexed_count`) exists in the index metadata, but `search` does not currently print it in the reply."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the reply does not list the not-indexed file types. It gives scope fields (extensions indexed) instead, which is not the same as naming in-scope file types that produced no rows.
